Classification: The Seventh High Clan (now a hunted bloodline)

Once one of the original High Clans of the Second City, founded by the Antediluvian Saulot, the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.Ei698TPekL0hRbUS]{Salubri} were fierce warriors and mystic healers who have almost entirely vanished in recent nights. Rumor blames infernalism, or the destruction of Saulot at the hands of the upstart @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.jaYCq9rVOh0I9NCN]{Tremere} clan — a claim the young scoff at but that elders watch with growing unease as Tremere fortunes rise. Salubri divide into warrior and healer castes, both once governed by the Code of Samiel, a lost warrior's code that has since been only imperfectly reconstructed. The Tremere actively hunt the Salubri to erase evidence of their crime, spreading lies that brand them as secret servants of Hell, and rumors speak of an alliance between rogue Tremere and the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali} (the Salubri's ancient enemy) to share intelligence on remaining Salubri.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Valeren

Advantage: Salubri begin character creation as 10th generation instead of the normal 12th. They also gain a level of Linguistics: Enochian, a dialect of the Second City used among themselves.

Disadvantage: A warrior Salubri cannot refuse to aid someone in need without suffering a two-Trait penalty on all challenges until she makes some restitution. A healer Salubri may never harm another, even in self-defense, without suffering a two-Trait penalty on all challenges for the rest of the scene. Any use of Valeren above the Basic level opens the Salubri's third eye; covering it imposes a one-Trait penalty, and many powers cause it to emanate light, making concealment difficult.

Organization: Scattered survivors in hiding, divided into warrior and healer castes, desperately searching for lost copies of the Code of Samiel while being hunted by the Tremere and remaining enemies of the Baali.

Suggested Viae: Heaven, Humanity, Kings.
